news.title: Cartersville police arrest man after decomposed pet found on doorstep
news.summary: A Cartersville man was arrested after police said he left his about to be ex-wife's dead, decomposed dog in a crate on her boyfriend's doorstep alongside a threatening message.

news.title: ‘Incendiary device’ thrown at ICE building, FBI says
news.summary: Atlanta police confirmed they are responding to a report of a possible object being thrown at 180 Ted Turner Dr. SW.

news.title: Woman granted protective order against former deputy accused of harassing her on social media
news.summary: A woman has gained legal protection against a former Cherokee County deputy accused of harassing her on social media.

news.title: Police search for suspects after 13-year-old shot in Atlanta apartment
news.summary: Atlanta police are searching for multiple suspects after a group allegedly opened fire on a southeast Atlanta apartment early Sunday morning, injuring a 13-year-old boy inside the home.

news.title: Poll shows virtual tie in Georgia governor’s race
news.summary: A new Atlanta Journal-Constitution poll shows Republican Rick Jackson and Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms are in a virtual dead heat.

news.title: Former sheriff says credit union denied $3.4K fraud claim after France pedicab ride
news.summary: A Rockdale County man says what was supposed to be a 30-euro pedicab ride in Paris turned into a $3,400 credit card charge and months of frustration after his fraud claims were repeatedly denied.

news.title: Police say man groped 3 women at metro shopping center in just 10 minutes
news.summary: Orlandus Sims was arrested in Cobb County after allegedly groping three women at three stores in just 10 minutes.

news.title: Police say thieves used a ladder to steal $8,000 from metro storage unit
news.summary: A man faces charges after thieves climbed into a Cobb County storage unit to steal TVs and sensitive personal documents.
